question: Does pydantic-ai actually enforce typed, validated outputs end-to-end when an Agent is run with a structured output_type, as the README claims?

report.repository_description: pydantic-ai is a Python library for building agents that call language models and validate their outputs using Pydantic models.
report.question: Does pydantic-ai actually enforce typed, validated outputs end-to-end when an Agent is run with a structured output_type, as the README claims?

ledger.statement: Repository is pure Python, MIT-licensed, and small enough to clone, making the claim directly testable in the sandbox.

After cloning the repo and installing pydantic_graph and pydantic_ai_slim in editable mode, running Agent(TestModel(), output_type=City).run_sync produced a result.output that is an actual instance of the user-defined City Pydantic model, printing "OK name='a' country='a' <class '__main__.City'>".

When the test model was forced to emit output violating the schema (country set to int 123 instead of str), pydantic-ai caught the mismatch internally, performed an automatic output retry, and ultimately raised UnexpectedModelBehavior: Exceeded maximum output retries (1), showing validation is applied inside the agent loop itself.

facts.headline_capability: Validates and coerces model outputs into declared Pydantic output_type, retrying and raising on persistent validation failure.
facts.observed_output: OK name='a' country='a' <class '__main__.City'>; UnexpectedModelBehavior: Exceeded maximum output retries (1)

report.summary: Yes: pydantic-ai's agent loop genuinely validates model output against the declared output_type, coercing conforming responses into real class instances and catching/retrying non-conforming ones before ultimately raising an error. This was confirmed by directly running the agent with a fake test model under both valid and invalid output conditions.
limitations: Only the synchronous local TestModel fake backend was tested, not a real LLM provider's wire format or async streaming output.
The internal retry/validation source code was not inspected line-by-line; behavior was inferred from black-box exception output.
Nested or union output_type edge cases were not tested.

from pydantic import BaseModel

    country: str
